html:
Dass Metal joined developers, contractors, and partners at 799 Sheppard Ave W to celebrate a key milestone on Friday, September 12th— the Top Off event, marking the completion of the concrete frame at The Hawthorne Residences.

Led by GCL Builds and Pinemount Developments Ltd., this project combines architectural design with structural resilience. Dass Metal was proud to be recognized as part of this achievement. Our role in supplying steel and metal studs demonstrates our commitment to supporting construction partners with reliable, high-quality products delivered on time.

The Hawthorne Residences

The Hawthorne Residences is a thoughtfully designed mid-rise condominium located at 799 Sheppard Avenue West, Toronto. The development brings together modern architecture, quality construction, and community-centered design. It marks a major milestone for urban residential projects in the Greater Toronto Area.

The design emphasizes comfort, lifestyle, and long-term structural integrity.

Dass Metal – Our Commitment

At Dass Metal, we supplied steel and metal studs that brought precision and durability to the Hawthorne project. With our advanced in-house manufacturing capabilities, we ensured:

  • High-volume production without compromising quality.
  • Certified steel products that meet Canadian building standards.
  • Fast turnaround times to keep the project moving seamlessly.

Dass Rebar: Reinforcing the Build

In addition to Dass Metal products, Dass Rebar supplied over 1,000 metric tons of MTO Approved Grade 400W rebar, fabricated and delivered with precision. Together, Dass Metal and Dass Rebar provided a comprehensive package of steel and rebar products, reinforcing JDass Corp’s position as a trusted partner for Ontario’s largest builds.

GCL Builds

GCL Builds has developed a strong reputation for delivering high-quality construction projects across Ontario. Their leadership in managing large-scale residential builds was evident at The Hawthorne, where they coordinated resources, managed timelines, and ensured the build stayed on track.

Pinemount Developments Ltd.

As the developer behind The Hawthorne Residences, Pinemount Developments Ltd. is dedicated to creating vibrant, sustainable communities across Ontario. Their focus on quality and value is reflected in every phase of this project, supported by partnerships with suppliers like Dass Metal and Dass Rebar.

Special Recognition

Special acknowledgement to Johnny Makdisi (Sr. Project Manager), Hamzah Mukbel (Project Coordinator) and Alex Aneziris (Senior Site Superintendent), whose leadership and professionalism were vital to the project’s success.

JDass Corp – A Stronger Future Together

Dass Metal and Dass Rebar are part of JDass Corp, a Canadian company with nearly 40 years of multi-industry leadership. JDass Corp manages a diverse portfolio in construction, real estate, metals, retail, finance, hospitality, and entertainment, contributing to Ontario’s economy and community development.

JDass Corp’s brands include:

  • Dass Rebar
  • Dass Metal
  • Quick Scrap Metal
  • Mississauga Convention Centre
  • Food World Supermarket
  • Shanty Bay Golf Club
  • Hotel Est
  • Skye Hotel & Residences
  • Meadowvale Apartment Hotel
  • The Play Scape

Guided by the motto Tomorrow’s Vision, Today, JDass Corp delivers sustainable growth and innovation across Canada and the US.

Conclusion

The Hawthorne Residences is more than a project—it is a symbol of collaboration, innovation, and quality. Dass Metal is proud to have supplied metal products that met the project’s demands.

At Dass Metal, we continue to support projects across Ontario with precision, durability, and certified quality—because building stronger futures starts with stronger materials.

Dass Metal – Trusted Metal Products Supplier Across Canada.
